config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-01: FHIRPath — §4.1 Literals. Test these items: Boolean literals; String literals; Integer literals; Decimal literals; Date literals; Time literals; DateTime literals; Quantity literals (incl. time-valued quantities). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.
